formula_basis: ES_hist = (1/k) × sum of the k largest losses, where k = ceil(n × (1−α)), with n=20, α=0.975, per the 97.5% tail average definition; MAR33 is silent on fractional treatment, so this convention is stated explicitly.
weakest_point: small sample and arbitrary fractional-observation convention; different conventions (e.g., linear interpolation) yield different ES
